BiblicalUsage: tsᵉrîy is the word for balsam, balm. In Genesis 37:25, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, and it appears again in Jeremiah 8:22.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that God put tsᵉrîy exactly where it is, and I trust His placing of it.
